text.jp:
まあ、救世主さま。
ようこそお越しくださいましたわ。
text.official_en: Thank you for coming, Promised One.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
周辺で怪我をした人や避難民を
収容して、治療を行っているところですの。
text.official_en:
I want you to know that we're doing all we can to
treat the injured and help refugees.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……皆、頑張っておりますわ。
自分たちが生きるための戦いを。
text.official_en: Everyone is fighting to survive this dark time.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも、皆がこうして希望を持っていられるのは、
救世主さまのおかげだと思っておりますの。
text.official_en:
But I believe that fight is only possible because you
inspire them to hold hope in their hearts.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
――そうでしたわ、わたくし、救世主さまに
お願いしたいことがあったのでした。
text.official_en:
On that front, there is something I need to ask
of you.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
治療に使う薬がどうしても足りなくて、
どこからか調達しなければならないのですけど。
text.official_en:
We are desperately short on medicine, with no new
supplies coming our way.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だけど、薬不足はどこも同じ。この神殿が
買占めを行うわけには参りませんわ。
text.official_en:
The shortage is felt everywhere, and the temple
must not hoard its supply.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
薬そのものが手に入らなくとも、
いくつかの材料さえ手に入れば、
text.official_en:
I don't need the finished medication to help. If I can
get hold of the ingredients...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
昔スミルノスのおじさまから教わった製法で
薬を作ることができる筈なのですが……
text.official_en:
I should be able to make medicine using the recipe I
learned from my uncle Smyrnos a long time ago.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
その素材を、集めて来て貰えませんか？
もちろん無償で……などとは言いません。
text.official_en:
I'd be happy to compensate you for the trouble of
gathering the ingredients for me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
最上級の兵種の試験を受けられるなど、色々な
お礼を用意しておきます。お願いしましたよ。
text.official_en:
Perhaps you'd be interested in taking a master class
exam? Let's talk once you've found the ingredients.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まあ！　救世主さま、
材料を見つけてきてくださいましたのね。
text.official_en: You've gathered the ingredients I asked for?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
これで、多くの方々を救うことができますわ。
本当にありがとう。
text.official_en:
This will help us to save many lives. Thank you
so much.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あなたはこうして、各地で人々を救っているのね……
わたくしも、その力になりたいわ。
text.official_en:
Your work has saved so many people. I want to help
in any way I can.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まず約束通り、あなたに「バトルモンク」の
資格試験を受けられるようにしましょう。
text.official_en: So, as promised, you can now take the <#CTRL:0E><#CTRL:08>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そして、この神殿の神の道の門を開放します。
これからは自由に使ってください！
text.official_en:
Also, I'll open the Gate of the Gods to this temple.
Feel free to use it whenever you need!
text.real_en:
Also, I'll open the Gate of the Divine Path to this temple.
Feel free to use it whenever you need!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それから、我がアウロラ神殿の、
試練を受けられるように手配しましょう。
text.official_en:
I will also arrange for you to take on the trial at
my temple.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その試練を乗り越えれば、あなたは「アーク」が
使えるようになります。戦いにきっと役立つわ！
text.official_en:
Overcoming that trial will allow you to use my Arc.
I imagine you'll find it very useful in battle!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アウロラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
神殿の人に話しかければ、試練に挑めます。
うふふ……好きな時に挑戦してみてくださいね。
text.official_en:
Just speak to someone at the temple to take the trial
anytime you like.
